title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I didn’t ask it but I don’t think he would have been prepared
I’m taking a different tact, instead of blowing him up on it, if that makes any sense
I think it’s a real sensitive issue and I think given what I’ve said about him not being prepared and being unpolished, I would have been going for the shock value.
When, really, nobody asked it (not that I expected they would), so I could talk to Ron and kinda, come up with a way for him to look better in the deal
Yeah, because in Al’s defense, he probably has some good thoughts on it. But he’s barely able to compose a sentence when he’s been prepared, so he reallyyyyy needs time to prepare
